items.exampleZh: 我聽到一個奇怪的聲音。

items.sentenceEn: Go straight, and you will see a yellow house.
items.sentenceZh: 直走，你會看到一棟黃色的房子。

items.audioEn: My phone is old and very slow.

items.sentenceEn: Keep your room clean and dry.
items.sentenceZh: 保持你的房間乾淨又乾燥。

items.sentenceEn: It is cold, so I wear a thick coat.
items.sentenceZh: 天氣冷，所以我穿厚外套。

items.stemEn: It did not rain this week. The ground is ____.
items.stemZh: 這個星期都沒下雨，地面是乾的。

items.passageEn: Yesterday, I saw a strange cat in my yard. It was very thin and yellow, and it had one blue eye and one green eye. It was also slow, so maybe it was hungry. I gave it some water and a clean towel. Now it sleeps in a dry box in my kitchen.
items.passageZh: 昨天我在院子裡看到一隻奇怪的貓。牠很瘦，是黃色的，一隻眼睛是藍色、一隻是綠色。牠動作也很慢，也許是餓了。我給了牠一些水和一條乾淨的毛巾。現在牠睡在我廚房裡一個乾燥的箱子裡。

rubricZh: clean 可當動詞「把⋯弄乾淨」（例如 clean the table）
祈使句用動詞原形開頭；please 放句首或句尾都可以

referenceEn: This clock is five minutes slow.
The clock is five minutes slow.
rubricZh: 「慢了五分鐘」可寫，例如 is five minutes slow 等
「這個時鐘」可寫，例如 this clock、the clock 等
